Two odds formats you'll see on 899OK — switch between them in settings.
Decimal odds (default): Total return per ৳1 stake.
1.50 → ৳100 stake returns ৳150 (৳50 profit)
2.00 → ৳100 stake returns ৳200 (৳100 profit)
4.50 → ৳100 stake returns ৳450 (৳350 profit)
Fractional odds: UK style. 5/2 means ৳5 profit per ৳2 staked, plus stake back.
Implied probability shortcut: 1 ÷ decimal odds.
2.00 → 50% chance
4.00 → 25% chance
Handy when you're comparing 899OK odds against your own gut read. If you think a team wins 60% of the time and the odds show 40% implied probability, that's the kind of value bet you want.
